use.zh-cn: 任务/执行与预检权限及三态；replace需实例、插件及Provider，unsupported优先，写后仅扫目标表。表头/动态reader复用当前同格式Describe并保留Meta类型；已纳管native运行前按同投影核对实时结构，未纳管不加Catalog读取。以上执行行为不扩展停止态native创建，仍不执行、调度或扫描，encoded执行未建模。
use.en: Task/execution and read-only tri-state precheck; replace needs instance/plugin delete support and Provider, unsupported precedes unknown. Post-write scans target only. Headers/dynamic readers reuse same-format Describe results, preserving Meta types. Managed native execution checks live schema against the same projection; unmanaged reads add no catalog access. Execution details do not expand stopped native creation: no execution, schedules or scans; encoded execution remains unmodeled.

use.zh-cn: 委托创建仍限租户内停止态 bounded/snapshot/native table，无调度、扫描或执行。同步请求固化当前 AuthContext；人工角色执行与错误分类不扩张创建 Tool 权限，角色方式不接受委托身份。
use.en: Delegated creation remains tenant-scoped stopped bounded/snapshot/native table without scheduling, scanning or execution. Synchronous requests carry current AuthContext; manual role execution and error classification do not widen create Tool permissions, and role choices reject delegated identity.

use.zh-cn: 创建仍只保存 idle/stopped 定义：默认无新增角色或 EA 依赖，显式方式复核本人角色，委托不借用角色。新增私有保护记录仅用于已核验 Manager/Develop 来源的 ExportSession 一次性执行，不授予权限、不变换字段或写业务数据。导出生成与再次交付仍未建模，创建 Tool 的条件、确认和效果不变。
use.en: Creation still saves an idle/stopped definition; default choices add no role or EA dependency, explicit choices check the current User, and delegation borrows no roles. A private protection receipt is initialized only for verified Manager/Develop ExportSession ad-hoc executions: no grants, field changes or business writes. Export generation and redelivery remain unmodeled; create Tool conditions, confirmation and effects are unchanged.

use.zh-cn: 正式委托路由覆盖创建停止态与拒绝错误范围、执行、计划、扫描；新增角色选择请求必须 409，且零本人角色请求、不增加定义或执行。
use.en: The formal delegated route covers stopped creation and rejects wrong scopes, execution, schedules and scanning; a role-choice request must return 409 with no current-user role lookup or additional definition/execution.

use.zh-cn: 创建与预检共用唯一输入定义；创建 v3 保持标准字段类型及快照 replace/append，不接受 keys；预检声明独立只读 Tool、三项权限交集及受限三态报告
use.en: Create and precheck share one input definition; create v3 retains standard field types and snapshot replace/append without keys; precheck declares a separate read-only Tool, three-permission intersection and limited tri-state report

use.zh-cn: 核验 Tool 引用、创建参数和 owner HTTP 契约；标准类型与 Common 一致，非标准类型、快照 upsert 及 keys 在委托前拒绝
use.en: Verify Tool references, creation arguments and owner HTTP contract; types match Common; nonstandard types, snapshot upsert and keys fail before delegation

use.zh-cn: 事实获取、澄清与精确复核；用户正式确认后由 Runtime 刷新事实并沿原 Adapter 创建一次，稳定内容变化重新确认，失败不自动重试；模型不再决定恢复步骤或收尾。
use.en: Fact discovery, clarification and exact review; after formal confirmation Runtime refreshes evidence and creates once through the existing adapter, re-reviews changed stable content and never retries failure automatically; no model decision or closing text on resume.

use.zh-cn: Runtime 条件适配与能力修订、参数和结构事实的复核绑定；历史草稿复用同一完整参数摘要算法，创建条件和确认裁决不变
use.en: Runtime condition adapters and review binding to revision, arguments and schema facts; historical drafts reuse the exact argument digest algorithm without changing creation conditions or confirmation decisions

use.zh-cn: 验证条件拒绝、参数或事实变化后重新确认
use.en: Verify condition refusal and re-review after arguments or facts change

use.zh-cn: 正式支持矩阵区分快照 replace/append 与增量 upsert，不混用装载和写入方式；复核运行后仅扫描目标表，不扩大 schema／database；创建切片仍禁用自动扫描
use.en: Formal matrix distinguishes snapshot replace/append from incremental upsert; reviewed post-write scans restricted to the target table, without schema/database expansion; creation still disables automatic scanning

use.zh-cn: 确认恢复重读原参数、本体及源/目标父节点事实，正式复检匹配指纹后沿唯一Adapter、确认消费与提交屏障创建一次。稳定内容变化重新确认，失败不重试。同批用前序完成屏障按模型顺序执行，搜索失败或取消阻断排队调用；显式检查仍固定展示并结束，不放宽权限。
use.en: Runtime resumes exact arguments with fresh semantics, source/target-parent evidence and formal checks, creating once through the same guarded adapter after confirmation consumption and commit acknowledgement. Changed stable content requires review; failures are not retried. Predecessor gates preserve model order and block queued calls after search failure or cancellation. Explicit checks still display and stop without widening permissions.

use.zh-cn: 真实 Harness/Manifest/SDK 受控回归覆盖确认恢复零模型调用、精确参数创建一次、修订/事实/报告变化重确认后继续、取消、权限拒绝、unsupported、提交失败与结果不明不重试；不代表真实部署或 Hosted 验收。
use.en: Controlled real Harness/Manifest/SDK tests cover zero model calls and one exact-argument creation on confirmed resume, re-review after revision/fact/report changes, cancellation, denial, unsupported definitions, commit failure and uncertain writes without retry; not live-deployment or Hosted acceptance.

use.zh-cn: 显式预检的双语三态完成提示，以及确认恢复后仅基于正式创建响应的固定成功提示；失败不宣称已创建，unknown 不标为通过。
use.en: Localized tri-state explicit-check completion and fixed confirmed-resume completion based only on the formal creation response; failure never claims creation, and unknown is not passed.

use.zh-cn: 复核 KML 固定 CRS 与 encoded ORC 单文件 reader／源版本绑定；本轮只扩展未建模的 encoded 读取。停止态 native table 的 bounded/snapshot、replace/append、查询与字段资格校验，以及创建权限、条件和效果保持；不执行、调度或扫描。
use.en: Review KML fixed CRS and encoded ORC single-file reading with source-version binding. Encoded execution remains unmodeled. Stopped native creation retains bounded/snapshot, replace/append, query and field checks, permissions, conditions and effects; no execution, schedule or scan.

use.zh-cn: 精确历史参数只由受身份限定的已完成预检步骤恢复；普通确认从同一 Run/协议调用下本次复核的唯一自动预检建立引用，并核对参数、报告与确认指纹，不选最近草稿、不复制参数到检查点。
use.en: Exact arguments come only from identity-scoped completed check steps. Ordinary confirmation binds its unique automatic check within the same run/invocation, validating parameters, report and review fingerprint without selecting a recent draft or duplicating checkpoint arguments.

use.zh-cn: 纯解释与原参数创建区分；恢复按同用户/租户/会话重读摘要引用，仅把原参数和服务端恢复标志传入 Runtime，不导入历史权限；正式确认后的推进不依赖模型。
use.en: Separates explanation and exact-draft creation; resume re-reads the scoped digest reference and passes only exact arguments and a server-owned resume flag, without historical authorization; confirmed advancement does not depend on the model.

use.zh-cn: 完成步骤事务后按相同身份范围读取原输入，经唯一 A2UI 路径展示；实时与持久 parts 按事件顺序追加，后到文字不前置，完整 content 不截断。历史读取仍为 Runtime 审计，不注册业务 Tool、授予权限或创建任务
use.en: Read original inputs within the same scope after step commit through one A2UI path; live and persisted parts append in event order without moving later text first or truncating content. Historical reads remain runtime audits, not business tools, grants or task creation

use.zh-cn: 内存 SQL T1 验证同用户/租户/会话隔离与精确摘要；普通确认只关联本次同协议调用的唯一预检，拒绝缺失、歧义及改参，绑定原稿恢复仍重读引用；不代表真实 PG/T4。
use.en: In-memory SQL T1 verifies identity scope and exact digest restoration; ordinary confirmation binds only its unique same-invocation check, rejecting missing, ambiguous or changed arguments. Bound resume still re-reads the reference; not real PostgreSQL or T4 evidence.

use.zh-cn: 受控持久层消费真实 Chat 流验证完成预检步骤的身份范围、原参数及引用在 SSE、消息和回放中一致；卡片前后文字与失败文字按原事件顺序保存，content 完整，不作为真实数据库或部署验收
use.en: Controlled persistence consuming the real Chat stream verifies completed step scope, exact arguments and references across SSE, messages and replay; text before and after cards and failure text retain event order and complete content, not live database or deployment acceptance

use.zh-cn: 只合并相邻文字，不跨 Presentation 重排；持久化仍使用原字节上限和深复制，不过滤内容
use.en: Merge only adjacent text without reordering across presentations; persistence retains byte bounds and deep copying without filtering content

use.zh-cn: 验证空 delta、相邻合并与卡片后的新文字段，不丢弃模型输出
use.en: Verify empty deltas, adjacent merging and new text after cards without dropping model output

use.zh-cn: 从同一已预检参数显示受限事实概要，复用共享定位符、表格和 JSON；不新增摘要 props、推测业务事实或任务状态，不发 action 或请求
use.en: Display bounded facts from the same checked arguments using shared locators, tables and JSON; no summary props, inferred business facts or task state, actions or requests

use.zh-cn: 核对概要和原参数一致、双语、路径与名称转义、缺失事实不猜测、完整 JSON 和无 action；Catalog 拒绝越界和额外属性
use.en: Verify same-argument facts, languages, escaped paths and names, no invented missing facts, complete JSON and no actions; Catalog rejects oversized and extra properties

use.zh-cn: 实时和安全事件回放只追加相邻文字段，不把模型解释移到此前卡片之前，不过滤或修订既有历史消息
use.en: Live and safe event replay append adjacent text without moving explanations before preceding cards or filtering or revising existing history

use.zh-cn: 请求级 TaskContext 携带服务端 Interaction 恢复标志与临时原参数；语义 checkpoint 仅保存引用，不保存第二份参数或模型状态。
use.en: Request-local TaskContext carries the server-owned Interaction resume flag and temporary exact arguments; semantic checkpoints retain only the reference, not duplicate arguments or model state.

use.zh-cn: 检查点只保存原草稿控制引用，不持久化第二份参数；恢复拒绝错误引用类型，仍保留当前 Run 原有事实与复核边界，不导入旧 Run
use.en: Checkpoint stores only the draft control reference, not a duplicate payload; restoration rejects wrong reference types and retains current-run evidence and review boundaries without importing an old run

sources.anchor: test('exact checked draft streams and reloads

use.zh-cn: T3 用生产 UI 和协议客户端、受控 HTTP/SSE 记录实时 DOM 顺序，并核对刷新后的参数、引用和顺序；禁止夹具访问个人服务，不宣称自由模型或 Hosted T4 验收
use.en: T3 production UI and protocol client with controlled HTTP/SSE record live DOM order and verify reloaded arguments, reference and order; fixtures forbid personal service calls and do not prove free-model or hosted T4 acceptance

use.zh-cn: 角色方式保存只消费当前第一方 User 的角色事实；无选择直接返回。角色手动执行需独立 EA，不赋予委托创建运行权。
use.en: Role-choice saves consume only current first-party User role facts; absent choices return directly. Manual role execution requires separate EA and does not grant delegated creation execution rights.

use.zh-cn: 本人角色读取要求未到期第一方 Tenant User，拒绝 Delegated／Service，不替换服务令牌、不保存凭据；不授予数据或执行权限。
use.en: Current role reads require a live first-party Tenant User and reject Delegated/Service identities without substituting service tokens or retaining credentials; no data or execution permission is granted.

use.zh-cn: 只接受已持久化的正式 Interaction 确认，普通创建绑定本次唯一预检引用后恢复原 Run；文字回答清除复核，不构成批准，不复制第二份参数。
use.en: Accepts persisted formal Interaction confirmation, binding the exact check reference before resuming the same run; text clears review rather than approving, with no duplicate argument store.

use.zh-cn: 真实Harness受控倒序到达稳定复现五类搜索错误的同批枚举竞态；严格断言无备用调用、无下一轮模型，另验证成功顺序、取消阻断与重复身份执行前拒绝。
use.en: Real-Harness controlled reverse arrival reproduces same-batch enumeration for five search errors; strict assertions forbid fallback calls or another model turn, with successful-order, cancellation and duplicate-identity rejection regressions.

sources.anchor: 同批 Tool 按模型返回顺序进入唯一 Runtime 调用路径

use.zh-cn: 搜索失败立即终止；同批按模型顺序执行，前序使Runtime失败/暂停/终止或取消后，后续不得进入Adapter，不以锁到达顺序或目录枚举替代。
use.en: Search failures terminate immediately; batches execute in model order and queued calls never enter adapters after Runtime failure, pause, termination or cancellation, without lock-arrival ordering or directory fallback.

summary.zh-cn: 只建未启动的 native table 有界快照任务，目标仅 replace/append；复核和创建前正式只读预检，unsupported 阻止创建，unknown 明示限制后知情确认；不保证实际值转换或执行成功，不是 Transfer 全功能声明
summary.en: Create only a stopped native table bounded snapshot task with replace/append; formal read-only checks precede review and creation, unsupported blocks creation and unknown requires informed confirmation; no guarantee of value conversion, execution success or full Transfer coverage

summary.zh-cn: Continuous/Kafka 与数据库 CDC尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Continuous Kafka and database CDC is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: Watermark 增量装载尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Watermark incremental load is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 执行、重试、调度及运行结果尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: Execution, retry, scheduling and runtime results is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 文件、对象与 raw copy 传输尚未纳入本能力定义
summary.en: File, object and raw copy transfer is not modeled in this capability

summary.zh-cn: 当前第一方 User 的角色专用字段方式、手动 EA 执行及导出交付尚未纳入本委托创建能力；不借用发布人、服务或委托人角色。
summary.en: Current first-party User role-specific field choices, manual EA execution and export delivery are not modeled by this delegated creation capability; publisher, service or delegator roles are not borrowed.
